Hannah (People Ops): Quick question for the team  Elena accepted the offer and says she's on L-2 with an EAD (card received, expires 2027-04-01) but her spouse's L-1 status paperwork is still in process. She wants to add spouse to benefits. Any blockers?
Kevin (Hiring Manager): We want her onboard 2026-07-05. Adding spouse day one would be ideal. Is that allowed if dependent paperwork is pending?
Elena (Candidate): I have my EAD card and passport scanned. Spouse doesn't have any US docs yet (applied abroad), but we can provide marriage cert and foreign passport for spouse. Can spouse be covered if not physically present in US yet?
Priya (Immigration Counsel): From an immigration perspective, your work authorization (L-2 EAD) is fine for employment and payroll. Dependent coverage rules are governed by benefit carriers, not immigration. Typically carriers require proof of relationship (marriage certificate) and sometimes proof of dependent residency. They usually don't demand immigration status for dependents at enrollment, but billing and payroll may require SSN later.
Mark (Payroll): Payroll-wise we need beneficiary info for pre-tax deductions. We can enroll spouse without SSN initially in many cases (enter placeholder) but we must update SSN when available for tax reporting. If spouse isn't in US and thus no SSN, benefits enrollment may be allowed but we need to track COBRA/TPA rules and address verification. We'll also need to confirm whether premiums for spouse are allowed if they live abroad.
Juno (Benefits): Carriers vary. Some carriers allow dependents living abroad if they are eligible and premiums are paid, others restrict coverage to US/Canada residents. For medical plans, network access will matter; international spouses may be out-of-network until they arrive. Dental/vision often more flexible. We need marriage cert and spouse DOB; carrier may ask for SSN later. I can check each carrier policy.

onboard-bot: Reminder: use secure HR portal to upload PII. Do not post documents here.

Elena (Candidate): Thanks. I can upload marriage certificate and spouse passport to the portal. Spouse hopes to arrive by August but not certain.
Hannah (People Ops): Action items: 1) Elena to upload marriage cert + spouse passport scan. 2) Juno to confirm carrier rules about non-US resident dependents and SSN timing. 3) Mark to outline payroll steps for placeholder SSN and retro-updates. 4) Priya to confirm any immigration nuance for L-2 EAD holders adding dependents.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Quick note: nothing immigration-specific prevents covering a spouse; but if spouse later receives dependent visa or SSN, we must update employment/benefits records accordingly. No I-9 impact for spouse.
Juno (Benefits): I'll check major carriers (BlueCross, United, Delta Dental) and report within 24 hours. Preliminary: medical likely needs US address; dental okay with foreign address in some plans. Employer-sponsored international coverage exceptions are rare.
Mark (Payroll): For payroll, we can add spouse as a dependent without SSN and use code "TBD-000" as placeholder. We must replace placeholder with SSN within 60 days of receipt to avoid tax issues. If spouse never gets SSN, we'll document reason and report accordingly. I'll draft steps and forms.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Nothing further from immigration. L-2 EAD means Elena can work and be paid normally. If spouse later obtains dependent visa or SSN, update records. No I-9 reverification needed for Elena until EAD expiration.
Hannah (People Ops): Great. I'll message Elena the benefits memo and ask whether she wants us to attempt enrollment on 7/05 or wait until spouse arrives. Elena, preference?
Elena (Candidate): Let's attempt enrollment on 7/05 and we can cancel if carrier says no. I prefer to have coverage lined up.
Kevin (Hiring Manager): Sounds good. Ready to onboard 7/05.
Hannah (People Ops): Closing loop: Juno will attempt enrollment and note carrier flags; Mark will set placeholder SSN; Priya confirms immigration OK. Elena please confirm spouse arrival timeline when you know. Welcome aboard!
Elena (Candidate): Thanks everyone  excited to start.
